item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 02/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, the areas of showers associated with an upper-air disturbance will depart gradually. The weather will be mainly fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. A band of rain and clouds will bring showers to Guangdong during the weekend.

Date/Month: 02/05 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Cool in the morning. Fewer showers during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
